usage: Bei6 refers to the nose, and it is a noun used to identify this specific body part.
You can use bei6 when talking about actions related to the nose, such as smelling or breathing.
Bei6 can appear in sentences where you describe symptoms or health conditions affecting the nose.
When giving directions for health advice, bei6 helps specify what part of the body is involved.
Bei6 can also be combined with adjectives or verbs to create descriptive phrases about the nose.

examples.meaning: My nose is blocked, I can't smell anything.
